stories.title: They graduated college, but they haven’t been able to use their degrees
stories.summary: Underemployment among 22-to-27-year-olds hit a six-year high. Graduates say any job is better than no job, but a low-paid retail position or gig work isn’t what they had in mind.

stories.title: Opinion: A felon’s presence on the ballot might have kept Bill Hill from defeating Nick Begich
stories.summary: A distant prison cell proved no obstacle to winning thousands of Alaska votes.

stories.title: Opinion: AIDEA needs to quit gambling away Alaska’s public dollars
stories.summary: The next governor can help put public benefit back at the center of AIDEA’s mission.

stories.title: Hegseth, Pentagon officials floated using wartime law to reappoint Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: The Cold War-era Defense Production Act gives presidents extraordinary power to intervene in the economy.

stories.title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday due to expected bad weather
stories.summary: The postponement came as New York City is set to get slammed by a storm bringing intense winds and rain to the region

stories.title: Woman dies, man rescued from house fire in Southeast Alaska
stories.summary: The fire in Klawock is under investigation by the local police department and Alaska State Fire Marshal’s Office.

stories.title: South High’s Division I-bound wrestlers reflect on journey, look to next chapter
stories.summary: Seniors Jacob Morris, Levi Shivers and Zane Gerlach are showing how student-athletes from Alaska can achieve ambitious goals.

stories.title: Wasilla woman dies in propeller incident at Big Lake airport
stories.summary: The 38-year-old drove onto a taxiway on Tuesday, then stopped and walked toward a small plane waiting to taxi, Alaska State Troopers said.

stories.title: This weekend in Anchorage: The Nutcracker, Turkey Trot and a downtown holiday tree lighting
stories.summary: Multiple downtown markets this weekend include Crafted in Alaska at the Anchorage Museum.

stories.title: As a writer and teacher, Peggy Shumaker’s influence has shaped Alaska’s literary community for decades
stories.summary: Though primarily known as a poet, her work as an instructor, editor, and writer are highly reputed.

stories.title: Alaska quietly gutted its cruise ship inspection program this summer
stories.summary: The moves represent the Dunleavy administration’s latest push to reduce state oversight of the cruise industry, which has a long history of environmental violations in Alaska.

stories.title: NASA hit an asteroid to test planetary defense. Here’s what happened.
stories.summary: In 2022, NASA slammed a spacecraft into a tiny asteroid — a rehearsal for if a space rock ever threatens Earth.
